Early/tail loops, put and WAdm_checkpoint stay conditional on that binding until a fresh body is proved equal to rawBytes (needs models for core::slice::chunks_exact_mut and WideExact::to_limbs, library externals).

array IntoIter (HM-D) and slice Iter (HM-B) models: the loop equalities hold with the gate list model for array IntoIter and the Aeneas library model for slice Iter; the fresh extraction leaves the array functions external, so they are bound by name. Row coverage is the lead decision.

<&Vec<T> as IntoIterator>::into_iter has no model in the Aeneas library: carried as parameter SVI with premise hS (non-vacuous). The lead assigns it to HM-B or another row, or a proof of an Aeneas library definition is added.

domain: the gate WAdm_checkpoint hard-codes variant S2, next 10 and 64 weights, so the equality holds only there; frozen checkpoint is general. Whether the release argument needs more than the S2 / next 10 domain is a security-contract question, not decided here.
